label: Walmart Marketplace
terms_note: Developer Portal terms; Solution Providers need approval for delegated access

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (client id + secret from the Developer Portal → POST /v3/token, 15-minute access tokens; Solution Providers get delegated access via seller approval)
sdks: official SDKs listed on the Developer Portal

rate_limits: token bucket per API with x-current-token-count / X-Next-Replenishment-Time; e.g. All orders 5,000/min, item setup spec 3 TPM/seller, lag time 20/h; 429 on exhaustion

auth: 1. Seller approved on Walmart Marketplace → Developer Portal → generate client id + client secret (or authorise a Solution Provider).
2. POST /v3/token (client_credentials, Basic) → access token valid 15 minutes; refresh on expiry.
3. Send the token + Walmart headers on every call.

endpoints.notes: spec by product type; poll feed status

endpoints.purpose: acknowledge, ship with carrier + tracking, cancel, refund

reference.limits: Token bucket per seller and per API: e.g. orders retrieval 5,000 / min, inventory 100–200 / min, items 10–900 / min, advertising 5–10 / min; headers x-current-token-count + X-Next-Replenishment-Time; 429 when empty; separate pools for Solution Providers. - Marketplace Retailer Agreement + Developer Portal terms; Solution Provider approval for delegated access. - US-only fulfilment (WFS or compatible), GTIN requirements (registry research).
mcp_sdk: SDK: official SDKs listed on the Developer Portal

sandbox.notes: Walmart Marketplace static sandbox (mock responses): base URL https://sandbox.walmartapis.com, listed as 'Sandbox URL' in the servers of Walmart's Token API reference (the Test Marketplace APIs guide calls https://sandbox.walmartapis.com/v3/inventory). Needs sandbox keys: Developer Portal > API Keys > Sandbox Keys (https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/sandbox-testing-for-marketplace-partners); production credentials are refused.

sandbox_dynamic.notes: Walmart dynamic sandbox (US only): same base URL plus the header WM_SANDBOX: v2 ('If the WM_SANDBOX header is omitted, null, or contains another value, the request is routed to the static sandbox'). Custom test data and multi-step workflows; inventory (/v3/inventory, /v3/inventories) and orders (/v3/orders…) are available, items are created through the Simulation APIs (/v1/simulations/items). Uses dynamic-sandbox credentials; production credentials cannot be used.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Walmart Marketplace API Client ID (Seller Center > Settings > API Key Management / Developer Portal, production keys).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The matching Client Secret; sent only as HTTP Basic to POST /v3/token, which returns a 15-minute access token sent as WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN.

config_fields.name: ship_node
config_fields.help: shipNode id for set_inventory when you have several ship nodes; empty = your default ship node.

adapter.terms: Walmart US Marketplace APIs: client-credentials token (15 min) from POST /v3/token, then WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN, WM_SVC.NAME and a fresh WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID on every call (the runtime sends a random 32-hex id per request via the signing hook). Price and inventory changes can take minutes to show on walmart.com.

me.note: Token detail: expiry, validity and the scopes (orders, item, price, inventory…) granted to these API keys.

list_orders.note: All orders (last 180 days, seller-fulfilled): `since` = createdStartDate (ISO date/datetime; Walmart's default is 7 days ago); `status` = Created, Acknowledged, Shipped, Delivered or Cancelled (a purchase-order LINE status). Up to 200 per call; Walmart pages with an opaque list.meta.nextCursor query string (kept under raw), not page numbers, so narrow with `since` instead of `page`. orderDate and line details are in raw (orderDate is epoch ms).

update_listing.note: Update a price: sets the BASE price (USD) of one SKU (listing_id = your seller SKU). Only `price` is applied (required); title/description go through the item feed and stock through set_inventory. Allow up to five minutes to reach walmart.com.

set_inventory.note: Update inventory for one item: `sku` (your seller SKU) is required; the quantity is set in EACH at the configured shipNode (or your default ship node).

end_listing.note: Retire an item (listing_id = seller SKU): "it can take up to 48 hours for items to be retired from our catalog"; to sell it again the item must be set up anew.

not_offered.create_listing: New items are created only through the asynchronous item feed (POST /v3/feeds?feedType=MP_ITEM with the category's item spec: productIdentifiers, brand, category attributes, shipping weight — https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/item-management-api-overview); the vocabulary carries none of the required spec fields.
not_offered.mark_shipped: Shipping updates (POST /v3/orders/{purchaseOrderId}/shipping, https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/reference/shippingupdates) are per ORDER LINE: each orderLine needs its lineNumber, statusQuantity and trackingInfo (shipDateTime, carrierName.carrier, methodCode); line numbers are not a vocabulary input.

evidence: host marketplace.walmartapis.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 5/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
auth_audit.notes: POST /v3/token answers a bare 400 'Bad Request' to a dummy client even with the documented WM_SVC.NAME / WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID headers (a UUID correlation id changes nothing), where an OAuth error was expected; the API calls themselves answer 401 UNAUTHORIZED.GMP_GATEWAY_API, and the reference pages list only WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN, WM_SVC.NAME and WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID as headers, as the adapter sends.
